capabilities: Zoom the whole window in and out with Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Scroll
Zoom out below the default minimum down to about 40%
Jump to a preferred zoom level with a command
Configure minimum and preferred zoom bounds in settings
extras: Desktop only; it controls the Electron window zoom and does not run on Obsidian mobile. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: It also lets you zoom out further than Obsidian's built-in limit
problem: Obsidian's built-in zoom has a limited range and no quick scroll-based way to zoom, making large tables, graphs, or wide notes hard to fit on screen.
summary: Adds Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Scroll zoom for the whole Obsidian window, with an extended zoom-out range below the built-in ~63% limit.
